<svg viewBox="0 0 700 238" class="chart diag" role="img" aria-label="GSC 的两条支路：上支路固定波束输出目标加噪声，下支路阻塞矩阵挡掉目标只留噪声参考，自适应滤波后相减；导向误差让目标漏过阻塞矩阵，造成目标抵消">
<defs><marker id="gsa" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--text-2)"/></marker><marker id="gsh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--hot)"/></marker><marker id="gss" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s1)"/></marker></defs>
<text x="10" y="18" class="ct">GSC：把带约束的问题拆成"固定波束 + 无约束自适应"<tspan class="cu"> · 与 MVDR 等价</tspan></text>
<text x="14" y="108" class="bsub">x(ω)</text>
<line x1="46" y1="100" x2="86" y2="100" class="ar" marker-end="none"/>
<circle cx="86" cy="100" r="3" fill="var(--text-2)"/>
<path d="M86,100 L86,58 L126,58" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/>
<rect x="130" y="38" width="108" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="184.0" y="55.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">固定波束 w_f</text><text x="184.0" y="69.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">指向目标，不自适应</text>
<line x1="238" y1="58" x2="320" y2="58" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/><text x="244" y="50" class="arlab halo" text-anchor="start">d(ω)：目标 + 噪声</text>
<rect x="324" y="38" width="66" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="357.0" y="62.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">延迟对齐</text>
<line x1="390" y1="58" x2="452" y2="58" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/>
<path d="M86,100 L86,150 L126,150" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/>
<rect x="130" y="130" width="108" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="184.0" y="147.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">阻塞矩阵 B</text><text x="184.0" y="161.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">B·a = 0，目标被挡掉</text>
<line x1="238" y1="150" x2="320" y2="150" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/><text x="244" y="142" class="arlab halo" text-anchor="start">u(ω)：只剩噪声</text>
<rect x="324" y="130" width="66" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="357.0" y="154.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">自适应 a</text>
<path d="M390,150 L462,150 L462,80" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/>
<circle cx="462" cy="58" r="15" class="bx-a"/>
<text x="462" y="63" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">Σ</text>
<text x="447" y="46" class="bsub">+</text>
<text x="447" y="82" class="bsub">−</text>
<line x1="477" y1="58" x2="528" y2="58" class="ar" marker-end="url(#gsa)"/>
<text x="532" y="62" class="blab">y(ω)</text>
<text x="532" y="78" class="bsub">= d − aᴴu</text>
<path d="M184,170 L184,194 L232,194" class="ar-h" marker-end="url(#gsh)" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
<text x="240" y="198" class="bsub" fill="var(--hot)">导向有误差 → B 挡不干净 → 目标漏进参考支路 → 被当噪声消掉</text>
<text x="14" y="224" class="arlab">"目标抵消"在 GSC 里的位置因此非常具体：不在自适应算法，在阻塞矩阵。</text>
</svg>

<defs><marker id="mba" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--text-2)"/></marker><marker id="mbh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--hot)"/></marker><marker id="mbs" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s1)"/></marker></defs>
<text x="10" y="18" class="ct">Mask-based 神经波束：网络只出掩码，空间滤波仍是闭式解<tspan class="cu"> · 当前的工业最优组合</tspan></text>
<text x="12" y="72" class="bsub">M 路时域</text>
<line x1="72" y1="66" x2="104" y2="66" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<rect x="108" y="46" width="70" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="143.0" y="70.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">STFT</text>
<line x1="178" y1="66" x2="212" y2="66" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<rect x="216" y="40" width="96" height="52" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="264.0" y="63.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">神经网络</text><text x="264.0" y="77.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">通常只吃 1 路幅度谱</text>
<line x1="312" y1="66" x2="352" y2="66" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/><text x="332.0" y="58" class="arlab halo" text-anchor="middle">掩码</text>

<rect x="356" y="70" width="100" height="30" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="406.0" y="89.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">M_n 噪声掩码</text>
<path d="M456,49 L478,49 L478,66 L492,66" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<path d="M456,85 L478,85 L478,66" class="ar" marker-end="none"/>
<rect x="496" y="46" width="92" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="542.0" y="63.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">加权估协方差</text><text x="542.0" y="77.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">R_s / R_n</text>
<path d="M542,86 L542,120 L306,120" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<rect x="206" y="126" width="100" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="256.0" y="143.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">MVDR / GEV</text><text x="256.0" y="157.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">闭式解，无训练</text>
<path d="M178,66 L178,146 L202,146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>

<line x1="306" y1="146" x2="356" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<rect x="360" y="126" width="62" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="391.0" y="143.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">BAN</text><text x="391.0" y="157.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">GEV 才需要</text>
<line x1="422" y1="146" x2="466" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<rect x="470" y="126" width="70" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="505.0" y="150.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">ISTFT</text>
<line x1="540" y1="146" x2="580" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#mba)"/>
<text x="584" y="150" class="bsub">增强信号</text>
<text x="10" y="196" class="arlab">关键在于：网络<tspan class="hot-t">不直接输出音频</tspan>，只输出"哪些时频点是噪声"。所以它不引入非线性失真，</text>
<text x="10" y="212" class="arlab">换个房间也不会崩——崩的只是掩码精度，而波束依旧是那个有解析保证的解。</text>

<svg viewBox="0 0 700 226" class="chart diag" role="img" aria-label="球阵处理链：球谐变换换基、模态均衡除以 b_n、选择模态权重 c_n、再任意转向；模态均衡是低频噪声放大的来源">
<defs><marker id="sca" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--text-2)"/></marker><marker id="sch" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--hot)"/></marker><marker id="scs" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s1)"/></marker></defs>
<text x="10" y="18" class="ct">球阵处理链：先换基，再均衡，最后才谈波束<tspan class="cu"> · 与线阵最大的结构差别</tspan></text>
<text x="12" y="76" class="bsub">Q 路球面麦</text>
<line x1="78" y1="70" x2="110" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#sca)"/>
<rect x="114" y="50" width="96" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="162.0" y="67.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">球谐变换</text><text x="162.0" y="81.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">p_nm = Yᴴ p</text>
<line x1="210" y1="70" x2="252" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#sca)"/>
<text x="231" y="106" class="arlab" text-anchor="middle">(N+1)² 个模态</text>
<rect x="256" y="50" width="110" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-h"/><text x="311.0" y="67.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">模态均衡 1/b_n</text><text x="311.0" y="81.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">把球的散射除掉</text>
<line x1="366" y1="70" x2="408" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#sca)"/>
<rect x="412" y="50" width="100" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="462.0" y="67.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">选 c_n</text><text x="462.0" y="81.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">决定方向图形状</text>
<line x1="512" y1="70" x2="552" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#sca)"/>
<rect x="556" y="50" width="96" height="40" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="604.0" y="67.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">任意转向</text><text x="604.0" y="81.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">只换 Y(û)，不重算</text>
<line x1="604" y1="90" x2="604" y2="116" class="ar" marker-end="url(#sca)"/>
<text x="614" y="112" class="bsub">y(û)</text>
<text x="14" y="148" class="arlab" fill="var(--text-3)">①　换基：把"哪个麦"换成"哪个空间模式"，此后与阵元位置无关</text>
<text x="14" y="169" class="arlab" fill="var(--hot)">②　全部代价在这：第 n 阶 |b_n| ∝ (kr)ⁿ，除它就是放大 6n dB/oct</text>
<text x="14" y="190" class="arlab" fill="var(--text-3)">③　c_n 全取 1 = 最大指向性；加权可换成旁瓣更低的形状</text>
<text x="14" y="214" class="arlab">对比线阵：线阵的权重把"频率"和"指向"绑在一起，换个方向要重算整组权重；球谐把这两件事彻底拆开了。</text>
</svg>
